notes.title: Last Cloudia x Street Fighter Collaboration Event Announced!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41034836/5b256cc7bc8093f455d8da4d601b2ccf190bb1f5.jpg[/img]
[TOKYO, JAPAN – Jan 18, 2024] AIDIS Inc. announced that from Jan 25, its popular mobile RPG Last Cloudia will host a collaboration event with the megahit fighting game Street Fighter. From Jan 18 until the start of the event, players can get items each day from an in-game collab countdown login bonus. Last Cloudia’s social media accounts will also celebrate the collab with a special video where Last Cloudia characters reenact the opening sequence of the arcade game Super Street Fighter IIX : Grand Master Challenge.

Then, on Jan 22, AIDIS Inc. will host an official livestream. Planned announcements for the livestream include further details about the event, such as characters and arks to be released, as well as the amazing promotions that will run during the event.

Fans of Last Cloudia and Street Fighter will surely want to check out these exciting promotions.

The opening video can be viewed here:
https://youtu.be/vF2mdbgUZY0



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41034836/1e6699fa707133359ea10a85900ce6c2e76a268a.png[/img]
[b]Collab Countdown Login Bonus[/b]

Players will be able to get a variety of items in this login bonus, which will be held until the start of the Last Cloudia and Street Fighter collaboration event. Details will be featured in an in-game notice.

Login bonus date and time:
Jan 18, 2024, 11:00 am – Jan 25, 2024, 10:59 am (PT)



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41034836/736b6106ce34586088b95be56dd8c6db153db76d.jpg[/img]
[b]Official Livestream Last Cloudia TV Collab Special[/b]

This livestream will feature a ton of information about the collaboration with Street Fighter, as well as details about some amazing promos running during the collaboration event!

Livestream date and time:
Jan 22, 2024, 7 pm (PT)

Livestream URL:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=oimMKgmUp24

Hosts:
Kit (PR Guy/ Localization Lead), Lemi Duncan (Sevia’s English Voice Actress)



[b]About the Street Fighter Series[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41034836/a167a82b6c01c2965398359d7806e1bf115fc5c8.jpg[/img]
The first game in the Street Fighter series was released in arcades in 1987. In 1991, Street Fighter II received much praise thanks to its innovative match system, becoming a huge hit. Since then, the series has recorded sales of more than 50 million copies (as of June 2023) in the 35 years since its first release, and continues to be a worldwide best seller. In recent years, it has also gained a presence as a leader in the competitive fighting game genre of esports. The latest in the series, Street Fighter 6 (released on June 2, 2023) has already sold more than 2 million copies worldwide.


[b]About Street Fighter 6[/b]
Street Fighter 6, released on June 2, 2023, is the latest entry in the world-class Japanese-developed fighting game series. In addition to well-known fan favorites such as Ryu and Chun-Li, a variety of new and interesting fighters have joined the mix. While the game includes the advances in multiple battle elements that traditional fighting game fans want, it also offers new modes like World Tour and Battle Hub and an easier-to-use modern control type, all of which are aimed more towards beginners and gamers who feel that fighting games are difficult.

Street Fighter official website: https://www.streetfighter.com/en

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41034836/0fd9b3fa2e18dddfe2660b9abed83b2748dda311.jpg[/img]
[TOKYO, JAPAN – May 18, 2023] AIDIS Inc. announced that from May 25, its popular mobile RPG Last Cloudia will host a limited-time collaboration event with Code Geass: Lelouch of the Rebellion.

In anticipation of this exciting event, a collab countdown login bonus will also be released. For the week before the event, players will be able to get a variety of items each day by logging into Last Cloudia.

On May 22, AIDIS will host an official livestream to celebrate this collaboration event. During the stream, information will be announced about the Code Geass: Lelouch of Rebellion units and arks, event gameplay, and in-game and social media promotions. Fans of both properties will want to drop in for more details about this exciting collaboration.

Leading up to this collaboration event, there will be a daily collab countdown login bonus from which players can receive a variety of items, including the item ★C.C.’s Pizza, which can be used to recover orange orbs. More details will be released through in-game notices.

[b]About Code Geass: Lelouch of the Rebellion[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41034836/6596243dffa145cab5759ee048952956d6367634.png[/img]
Set in a Japan occupied by world superpower the Holy Britannian Empire, Code Geass is an anime about a Britannian boy named Lelouch who uses a special ability called a “geass” with the power to control others to start a rebellion against his homeland.

From when it was first broadcast in 2006, Code Geass’ many fascinating characters and unpredictable story were met with overwhelmingly positive reactions. The subsequent Code Geass: Lelouch of the Rebellion R2, which was broadcast in 2008, depicts the fierce life story of the series’ protagonist Lelouch and brings the series to a magnificent conclusion.

Code Geass’ popularity has grown to the point that it has been called one of the representative anime works of the 2000s, and it continues to be passionately supported by its fans. For the 10th anniversary of Code Geass’ broadcasting, a three-part theatrical compilation film was released from 2017 to 2018, and in February 2019, a completely new sequel film, Code Geass: Lelouch of the Re;surrection, was released.

[TOKYO, JAPAN – Mar 9, 2022] AIDIS Inc. announced that from Mar 16, its popular mobile RPG Last Cloudia will host a limited-time collaboration event with the anime FULLMETAL ALCHEMIST BROTHERHOOD.

Livestream URL:
https://youtube.com/live/YV-P_wOWBDQ

Hosts:
Kit (PR Guy/ Localization Lead), Lemi Duncan (Sevia English Voice Actress)


[b]About FULLMETAL ALCHEMIST BROTHERHOOD[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41034836/67178c7b0180f0beda24e3fb15901e38902244e1.png[/img]

Alchemy is the science of understanding, decomposing, and reconstructing matter by the rules of “equivalent exchange.” Alchemists have a taboo, and it is “human transmutation.” Two young brothers, overcome with unbearable longing for their deceased mother, lose everything when they challenge this taboo.

The older brother, Edward Elric, wears an automail and goes by the alias “Fullmetal Alchemist.” The younger brother, Alphonse Elric, has his soul bound to a giant suit of armor.

The two brothers, in order to regain what they have lost, embark on a journey seeking the “Philosopher’s Stone.” As the siblings get closer to the truth behind the “Philosopher’s Stone,” they plunge deeper into the helix of a giant conspiracy.

The existence of those that are not human plotting in secrecy. The military nation of Amestris gradually starts to show its true nature. Endless grudges and desires for revenge of the oppressed citizens. The many tragedies brought forth by Alchemy. The tragedies dotting the world form a line in due time, gradually roping in people, the civilians, and even nations.

The brothers, caught between despair and hope, must keep moving forward—.
